description: Repo-scale (axum-bookclub): POST /api/clubs/:club_id/members/bulk-add must reject the whole batch if the CUMULATIVE member count would exceed the club's max_members - not check each member against a stale pre-batch baseline
prompts: Clubs gain an optional `max_members` field (a non-negative integer, or null/omitted meaning unlimited) - accept it in POST /api/clubs and return it in club responses. Add `POST /api/clubs/:club_id/members/bulk-add`: body `{"members": [{"name":..,"email":..}, ...]}`, adding every member to that club. It must be atomic: validate every member's name/email before creating anything. Critically, get the capacity check right: the invariant is that the club's member count (existing + everything in this batch, combined) must never exceed max_members. Compute the club's current member count and compare `current + batch_len` against max_members ONCE for the whole batch - do not check each member individually against the pre-batch count, since that lets a batch of several members sail past a cap that would reject them if counted together. Reject the entire batch (nothing created) with 400 if it would overflow.
